name: gravity-bounce-badge
title: Gravity Bounce Badge
description: A notification counter token dropping into screen space and settling via damped harmonic bouncing.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Trigger Drop Bounce: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
